title: Introduction to Python Backend
overview: Python can be used for backend development to create server-side applications, APIs, and web services. It handles business logic and communication between frontend and databases.

example.title: Backend Responsibilities
example.content:
✔ Handle requests
✔ Process data
✔ Connect databases
✔ Return responses

title: What is an API?
overview: An API allows different applications to communicate with each other by sending requests and receiving responses.

example.title: API Flow
example.content: Client → Request → API Server → Response → Client

title: Introduction to Flask
overview: Flask is a lightweight Python web framework used to create APIs and web applications with simple configuration.

example.title: Flask API Example

title: Creating API Routes
overview: Routes define different endpoints where clients can send requests to access backend functionality.

title: Handling API Requests
overview: Backend applications handle different HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE to perform operations on data.

example.title: HTTP Methods
example.content:
GET → Fetch data
POST → Create data
PUT → Update data
DELETE → Remove data

title: Connecting Python with Databases
overview: Python backend applications can connect with databases to store and retrieve application data.

example.title: Database Usage
example.content:
Python Backend
      ↓
Database
      ↓
Stored Application Data

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned the basics of Python backend development, APIs, Flask, routes, HTTP methods, and database communication.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Python can build backend systems.
✔ APIs connect applications.
✔ Flask creates APIs.
✔ HTTP methods manage data.
